requestedText: Separate supplier attribution from independent customer/IR corroboration in the bounded Weekly Radar reference-model source registry.

evidence: The registry is statically decoded by the existing CompanySourceRegistry boundary; the new list is explicit and does not resolve guessed URLs or dynamic code.
Only the repository-local Weekly Radar runtime consumes this registry; no external provider or paid API contract is added.
The configuration adds bounded source provenance only and introduces no telemetry, polling, webhook, or monitoring reference.
The Contract explicitly scopes both registry files, requires declared cross-origin URLs, and prohibits unbounded crawling and supplier-only independent claims.
